The '''Imperial River Base''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] installation near the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kepitenochan/Legends|Kepitenochan]]. Imperial forces from the base attacked the [[Government Tree]] in Kepitenochan during the [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|Liberation of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="GB" />
{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial River Base appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
